# P27 - Budget reservations and recorded actuals

Status: **blocked_external**. The independent local implementation is delivered. Actual independent concurrent sessions, institutional/provider/privacy/human acceptance remain unverified. No P28 implementation.

## Delivered behavior / interfaces

Migration035 `20261026003500_finance_ledger.sql`;77tables/853columns/103public functions. Four forced-RLS/raw-denied, immutable tables: budget_accounts, budget_entries, actual_finance_records, actual_finance_events. FIN policies optionally pin an immutable budget account and explicitly opt into reconciliation (`reconciliation_enabled`, default false). No actual account, policy, role, permission, threshold, balance or institutional designation is seeded. P26 single-stage/one-reviewer mapping limit remains.

Authorization insert reserves the exact ceiling less already booked case expenses in the same transaction as the canonical decision, receipt, audit and outbox. Account row locking precedes the available-budget check; insufficient funds roll back the authorization and decision. Every ledger insert locks its account and validates policy/account/reversal linkage and nonnegative available/reserved balances. READ COMMITTED is required by the authorization command. Accounts match organization/term/receiving unit/exact fund source and effective confirmation. Configuration is an approved administrative input, not an exposed browser operation. Revenue never raises a ceiling automatically.

Entries distinguish reservation, release, expense, revenue and reversal with integer centavo deltas. Expense booking consumes remaining reservation first and keeps booked use charged against available budget. Explicit request cancellation releases all unspent reservations once under ordered account locks, preserving booked expenses and history. Explicit FIN commitment cancellation appends revocation and once-only release; expired/superseded/revoked reservations remain held until release. Prior revision commitments can be read/released by the current independent assignee before replacement authorization. Reversals append a unique link to the original expense/revenue entry and refund booked use once; they do not recreate a cancelled commitment or delete history. No destructive editing or payment integration exists.

`record_finance_actual(work,kind,centavos,evidenceAsset,reference,date,reason,version,key)` records a positive expense or actual revenue with finalized same-case immutable uploaded evidence/hash, normalized reference, actual in-term nonfuture Manila date and current valid authorization. Duplicate evidence hash or normalized reference is rejected within term/kind, including reversed records. This is deterministic detection, not forensic identification of differently scanned receipts. `reconcile_finance_actual(record,book|reverse,reason,version,key)` appends booking/reversal events; `release_finance_budget(authorization,reason,version,key)` closes a financial commitment. All derive identity, validate current explicit policy/independent assignee/role/deployment/term, lock target/version, retry exact actor/key/payload and audit/outbox atomically. Generic department/PM access is insufficient.

An expense beyond the case authorization ceiling or enabled available budget remains an immutable **requires_review** documented record, with no expense booking or budget debit. It makes the safe delivery gate pending. Only a new valid reviewed authorization can book that record; reversal may explicitly withdraw an erroneous record with history retained. Case-wide booked expenses count across revisions. Requested amount, ceiling, reserved budget, booked expense, forecast and documented actual revenue remain distinct. Real revenue requires explicit evidence-backed recording; forecasts never populate actuals.

`read_finance_ledger(term,case)` audits restricted access and returns current case ledger/totals/latest100 actuals, held commitments and candidate receipt evidence only to the current independently assigned FIN reviewer with explicit policy opt-in. Requester/other head/member cannot read balances or actual-record references through it. Historical actual evidence is case-scoped under this current assignment; no historical review entitlement is created. Current actor/policy/role revocation removes reads/actions/bytes. Shared `read_finance_gate` still returns exactly pending/not_verified/authorized, without balances, receipt links, cases, counts or amounts; unresolved actuals/closed commitments cannot report authorized.

P12 file handling gains a file-only receipt path on valid approved FIN cases for the admitted requester or current independent assignee with policy opt-in. It does not widen `can_access_work(...,'edit')` or permit plan edits. Current receipt bytes/finalization are separate immutable assets/manifests; selected plan evidence/hash is unchanged. Current FIN candidate uploads and recorded historical receipts use the P22 virtual review download context, rechecking current scope. Approved FIN requests can be explicitly cancelled; existing general cancellation rules remain. Existing approved FIN revision path remains the only plan-change path.

`src/features/finance/Reconciliation.tsx` is embedded in `/finance/reviews/:term/:case`; ledger-api validates reads and exact success receipts. Identity-bound decision memory is reused with separate ledger namespace for uncertain frozen payload/key recovery; no optimistic booking or private browser persistence. Receipt upload-only controls reuse Files; same-name evidence includes a hash prefix. Native44px controls, focus,320px reflow and existing Karla/neutral/red tokens are preserved. Requester finance page accurately identifies restricted reconciliation instead of claiming no actuals exist.
